South Korea moves entire capital markets infrastructure onchain via Avalanche –
Link
South Korea's Financial Services Commission and Korea Securities Depository are laying groundwork to bring stocks, bonds, and funds onchain using Avalanche. The scope includes issuance, trading, clearing, settlement, and investor rights.
Matters because: this is one of the most ambitious government-led tokenization efforts to date and could support Avalanche's long-term institutional adoption narrative.

Coinbase files with SEC to offer equity perpetual futures –
Link
Coinbase filed registration documents on September 3 seeking approval to offer equity perpetual contracts, which would still require separate CFTC approval. Chief Policy Officer Faryar Shirzad described it as a potential regulated path for US investors into crypto-style derivatives on equities.
Matters because: if approved, it would show further convergence between crypto market structure and traditional equities trading, though the timeline remains uncertain.

Liquid Network hit by $320M exploit, transactions halted –
Link
A Bitcoin sidechain settlement layer used by several exchanges, Blockstream's Liquid Network, was drained of roughly 4,000 BTC (≈$320M) by attackers claiming to be "white hats." The network has been fully paused.
Matters because: The exploit adds to a recent run of major crypto hacks and could weigh on confidence in Bitcoin-adjacent infrastructure, even if the damage has been contained to the sidechain rather than BTC spot.
